newsitem.title: ITALY: Italian shares close lower in bout of profit takin.
newsitem.headline: Italian shares close lower in bout of profit takin.

text.p: 1640 GMT - Italian shares closed mostly lower on Tuesday as investors took the cue from a weaker bond futures market to reap profits in stocks, driving down leading blue chips although telecom shares made gains against the general trend.
* The all-share mibtel index finished 0.83 percent lower at 12,575 with the blue chip mib30 index ending the day 0.93 percent down at 18,717.
* Bellwether stocks led the declines, including ENI which shed 1.87 percent to 8,932 lire, Fiat, dropping 1.51 percent to 5,284 lire and Generali, off 1.15 percent to 33,162 lire.
* Snia jumped 1.83 percent to close at 1,835 lire while Snia Fibre ended 0.67 percent higher at 689.6 lire on renewed speculation of a merger between the two companies.
* Among telecom stocks, Telecom Italia shed 1.99 percent to close at 4,522 lire, Stet dropped 0.69 percent to finish at 8,136 lire.
* Mediaset sank 3.86 percent to end the day at 7,355 lire after Canal Plus launched an issue of bonds convertible into Mediaset stock. Milan newsroom +392-66102321
